risks.title: Commodity volatility and energy costs
risks.score_rationale: Major risk cited in executive summary (p.1) with intensive language ('could have an adverse effect'). Directly impacts gross margin and pricing competitiveness. Trend stable but exacerbated by geopolitics. High category weight for beverage sector.

risks.title: Dependence on independent distributors and retail consolidation
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited in risk summary (p.1) as key business risk. Moderate language but acknowledges structural vulnerability. Trend up: retail consolidation accelerating. Critical category weight for brewery distribution model.

risks.title: Changes in consumer preferences and product demand
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements (p.iii) and risk summary. Moderate language ('changes in consumer preferences'). Trend up: shift toward non-alcoholic, low-alcohol, alternatives. Very high category weight for brewery facing market disruption.

risks.title: Increased competition and industry consolidation
risks.score_rationale: Cited in forward-looking statements (p.iii): 'effects of competition and consolidation'. Moderate language but acknowledges structural competitive pressure. Trend stable but geopolitical context may accelerate M&A. Critical category weight for global leader.

risks.title: Damage to reputation and brand image
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in risk summary (p.1): 'Damage to our reputation or the image and reputation of our brands'. Direct and intensive language. Trend up: heightened sensitivity to ESG, alcohol, public health issues. High category weight for iconic brand portfolio.

risks.title: Government regulation and taxation of alcoholic beverages
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements (p.iii): 'changes in applicable laws, regulations and taxes'. Moderate language but structural risk. Trend up: excise taxes, advertising restrictions, environmental standards strengthening. Very high category weight for highly regulated alcohol sector.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and personal data loss risks
risks.score_rationale: Cited in forward-looking statements (p.iv): 'technological disruptions, threats to cybersecurity and the risk of loss or misuse of personal data'. Dedicated Item 16K on cybersecurity. Moderate language. Trend up: sophisticated attacks, supply chain threats. Growing category weight for digitalized group.

risks.title: Acquisition integration and restructuring risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements (p.iv): 'risk of unexpected consequences resulting from acquisitions, joint ventures...and our ability to successfully...integrate'. Moderate language. Trend stable but AB InBev historically active in M&A (SAB 2016, Budweiser APAC). Moderate category weight but high potential impact.
